newsitem.title: USA: Tripos to develop software for Pfizer.
newsitem.headline: Tripos to develop software for Pfizer.

text.p: Tripos Inc said Wednesday it entered into a sponsored research collaboration with the Central Research division of Pfizer Inc to design and develop new software products for pharmaceutical research.
Tripos said the multi-million-dollar agreement will focus on new and efficient ways to analyze the vast quantities of chemical and biological data now being generated in today's research environment.
Under the agreement, Pfizer will fund the research and development of new software tools, Tripos said.
